steps.text: Central District

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: H—help me...!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We're Reunion too! Why are you doing this? You Sarkaz always bite whatever hand feeds you!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...What's happening?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: The Sarkaz barricading the street are massacring Reunion...

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Captain?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Need to help the casualties.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: You are, Captain?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Mmhm. I'm going.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ngh... urgh... why, why! !

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: How did Reunion get like this... how did it get like this?! Weren't we gonna unite? Weren't we gonna be... be a family of our own, each other's kin?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: See you—

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Heavy-weapons throwers, careful!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Giant, floating weapons...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Was that you, Feline? You did that? You're—a Caster?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Put your weapons down.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's okay now. Go.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Go... go where? We've already... my teammates, my old friends, they all... they all...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Qing, help him.

steps.name: Qing
steps.text: Got it. Come here, brother. Those Sarkaz just don't see.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll say it again, Sarkaz. Put your weapons down.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You think we'll stop resisting just because you're holding a weapon.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We don't think that way.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Then you want to be killed?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We don't have much of a choice.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Attacking your own comrades, hurting your own kin—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: When were the Infected ever our kin? Our kin only numbers Sarkaz.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You couldn't have said that when you joined Reunion.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Betraying, harming your family, playing other people's feelings...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Disgusting.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Watch out for those weapons! Move!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis, stop...!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Ah, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Raidian just sent it out—the last message Dr. Kal'tsit gave us was that we should take care around the special Infected...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're likely a variant of the special Infected from Lungmen, and we don't know if they'll infect others in progression!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sarkaz warriors, listen to me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are some... Sarkaz with a deep infection, and they're catalyzing the other Infected!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need the other Infected to withdraw from their current areas... Your block still has Infected survivors apart from you, and they're all non-combatants!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if we won't pass through here, I still hope we can all lend a hand to ensuring the safety of those Infected!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: That's impossible. They wouldn't do that. They have no conscience.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We... we've seen it. We went out on our own.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We can't pull back. If they come this way... we'll have to get rid of them. We can't let even more Sarkaz get infected.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You might get infected yourself.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Who gives a damn.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You want to end up like them too? Those monsters controlled by Arts? You don't give a damn if you do?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Not the first time we've been made out to be monsters, is it?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Oh, um... ah.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: This city's toast. Sooner or later, sure, we might end up like them. But if we can exterminate them, then everything gets a little easier. Some people can still live on.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: As long as Talulah isn't dead, this city will be annihilated.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: If W can't kill her, there's no chance you can.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: If you don't stand with the winner, you can't win; in war, if you can't win, you die.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But if you keep hurting any more Infected, then this might be where you die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: And what if I die, then? What if I turn into one of Mephisto's Herd, huh...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Mephisto's a monster, too. We kill other Infected because we're all monsters.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: All we want is for the Sarkaz not to suffer any further, but when you think about it, what if we suffer?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: When you leave here and go whatever, will they look you in the eye?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Do you not know your end, being an Infected?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Of course you know. The moment you leave that tiny little squad of yours, you'll die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You'll be despised, wrung by the neck, lashed, whipped, and hung.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Or you'll be driven out of the cities, run vagrant, and you'll starve, bitten to death by the beasts.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You can't live on.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: And you have no dignity.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...What do you know?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Warrior...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Tell me. That you're not fighting for Talulah.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: She's... strong. With her, the chance that more people live on is better.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We don't care if we kill a few more for it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Get lost. Next time, I'll cut you in half.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Feline. If you want to pass through here, then just kill us...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We sure don't want to see our own end up that way. That's if you can kill us, though. Hahah.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You really are the most unsalvageable people.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What...? What?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What was... that sound?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, no...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The block we're in is nearing the ones the command tower closes off its entrances with... Reunion is likely trying to raise the entire sealing layer to cover any way in!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're almost out of time!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Sarkaz. I'll give you one last chance. If you don't want to get mangled, pull out.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: ...Heh. Hahah.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll settle this.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Cautus. Hah. What do you think you can do?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Black lines...? That's—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*. Ugh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's the... state of things?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: We've suppressed all consciousless Sarkaz mercenaries.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: O—okay, that's good, ngh... Are there other Infected.. here?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: We have news, but I can't say whether it's good or bad. Recon operators looked around a little. There are, all over this block. And most of them... are in terrible shape. They must've been passive Infected, imprisoned in concentration.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Any passage through the... sealing... layer?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Yeah, this part leads to an engineering passage. Should be able to directly enter the structural control area, hack their remote panels. They can't do a thing about that.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Otherwise, for the open passages, recon ops have sighted at least four battlegrounds, all of them guerrillas against other Reunion...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The combat situation seems intense...

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: The guerrillas are strong, but the Talulah-aligned Reunion have the terrain advantage, and Sarkaz mercenaries backing them. They won't be able to push through for a while.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: It's okay, Amiya. Captain, us engineers will sneak our way in. We'll cut the energy supply to the whole sealing layer.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Can you do it?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Definitely.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's too risky.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Entering the core city was risky in the first place.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No objections, then?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: We're going.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The, um... the, um!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Take care. Mm-hm... take care.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: We're not elite operator Rosmontis's squad for nothing. Don't you worry about a thing!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Put your own safety first.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: If you wanted us to listen, you wouldn't have used those Arts just now!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Engineering group, move out! Hustle your bustles!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...They're gone.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Oh. Amiya. You shouldn't use up your strength here. Let me handle all that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...This way, you'll be able to do less harm.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Does Rhodes Island not want me to do things this way?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's not it. It's just... if we could, we obviously don't want things done this way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And the only thing I've used up is strength. What you use up is... your awareness.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't really care.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... we should care.

steps.name: Qing
steps.text: Amiya! This fellow wants a few words with you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...You're from Reunion, Infected friend. Can I call you that?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Whatever. Just... whatever. We're all... done for. I wanted to ask where you're gonna go.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: And if... we can go with you, maybe. We've got nowhere to really go. The Sarkaz'll kill us, and we don't want to fight our own people anymore. The guerrillas'll kill us for sure, too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why do you feel that way?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: They'd kill anyone if they wanted, wouldn't they? I've heard there's times they say they'll kill the Infected, just because someone did something or other wrong!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I'm not sure. They might do that, but they might not.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My belief is, you have to see how they truly are to reach the facts. You can't just go on hearsay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we won't force you off to where they are. You're afraid of them, and the things they're doing don't sit well with you.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: And that's why I wanted to... to ask where you're all going.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —We're heading for the core command tower.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Are you insane?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We want to put a stop to this turmoil, so we have to head for the command tower.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can I ask you for a favor, Infected friend?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: If it's killing—then—then no.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not. I'm hoping you can all... safeguard the bystander Infected on this block.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Be careful. They might not like you... they might not like your uniforms.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Then what do we do?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think you have two options. One is, take off that uniform, and be Reunion no longer...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And the other is, wear your uniforms, but do what you should do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: One option is easy, and one's very hard, but I believe... this is something you should choose for yourselves.
Command tower entrance

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Curs! The cowards! They're blocking off the tower entrances with the sealing layers!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Have we still not breached them?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: The Sarkaz mercenaries are entrenching every sealing sector's in-roads! Other Infected have constantly been harassing us! We can't concentrate our attention!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You, repeat. You're asking us and Rhodes Island to cooperate?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I am!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: If Rhodes Island is unworthy of your trust, then you don't need to think about any of this city's people for a second more.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Even if the rules are going out of style, they'll still play by them.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Even if they still owe the Captain their lives?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: If we all die here, who'll carry on Patriot's spirit?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: We have strength, and Rhodes Island has knowledge. At the last, Kal'tsit's incredible on both counts. I personally think she's on par with the Captain. And you saw, even the Captain gave her his recognition!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: The sealing layer's still rising! You'd better decide, because we don't have much time left!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: That's more or less the shape of things. I've already told them about things, so, Amiya...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I'm not asking you to agree to this. I'm just thinking it might be good for us, right?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: It'll lead to a little less wounded all around...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...I'm not really on top of things. I just...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's alright, Guard. Your proposal is reasonable. It's just that we... we won't do things the same way the Shieldguards do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't have any right to exercise over the Infected, and we won't adopt their... disciplinary methods.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are they almost here?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Should be.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Amiya, I'm making less and less sense of anything.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: —Feline. I'm looking for your leader.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: If you want revenge, is now a good time?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Don't think you can try pissing me off just because you know a bit of Arts, white cat!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't like you.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Am I making you realize? The way you do things, you're no merchant's underling, eh? You're more like some Infected warrior hero, aren't you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Guerrilla fighter.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You can't threaten our employees. You don't have the authority.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...The Lord.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Can you command those Sarkaz?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I can't, and I couldn't. Please don't call me that. All I am is a member of Rhodes Island. Nothing to do with race, nor any arbitrary form of power.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Then that makes things simple, if you and them have absolutely no blood affinity.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You're going to team up with us here? Wreck the command tower together?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What're you so on guard for? We're obviously the ones yielding here.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The other guerrillas still don't know what I'm up to, but I have faith you feel the same way as them. This city's people are enslaved by Talulah and her wicked plans, and you too want to liberate them.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We want to revive hope for the Infected, so let's light one more flame for this city!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: if you truly fight for the Infected, then you're sure to agree.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Now answer, Rhodes Island!
